maddeler.e:
تنتهزون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَهِزُونَ (tantahizūna) /tan.ta.hi.zuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
# تُنْتَهَزُونَ (tuntahazūna) /tun.ta.ha.zuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
